MaintainX earned its reputation as a mobile-friendly CMMS with a real free tier. For small shops, that free Basic plan is often the first serious step off clipboards. Then growth hits the familiar wall: Essential at about $20 per user per month (annual), Premium at about $65 per user per month when inventory, meters, and API depth matter. This post is the companion to our[UpKeep alternative for small shops](https://www.taskade.com/blog/upkeep-alternative-maintenance-teams) . Same living-board approach, with MaintainX-shaped pricing and packaging.


[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/create) is not a full CMMS. It is not GPS fleet tracking. It is not a parts warehouse. It is a work-order and preventive-maintenance board you own, with agents and automations beside the records. If you need packaged CMMS depth day one, stay on MaintainX (or UpKeep, Limble, Maintoro). If you need an owned ops board without a per-tech tax climbing into Premium, generate the[MaintainX alternative PM board](https://www.taskade.com/generate/dispatch/maintainx-pm-board) and pair the[UpKeep alternative work order board](https://www.taskade.com/generate/dispatch/upkeep-work-orders) .


> **TL;DR:** MaintainX wins with a usable free Basic tier, strong mobile CMMS habits, and Premium modules for inventory and advanced PM. Taskade Genesis wins when small shops want work orders + PM intervals in a living app they reshape. Start free at[/create](https://www.taskade.com/create) , generate the PM board and work-order board kits, and keep GPS, payroll, and parts systems beside it instead of inventing them inside it.


Pricing uses publicly listed MaintainX ranges as of 2026 (annual vs monthly differ). Confirm live quotes.


---


## What small shops use MaintainX for


Most five-to-twelve person shops live in a narrow loop:


1. Someone requests a fix (app, text, walk-up).
2. A lead triages and assigns.
3. A tech completes with notes and photos.
4. PM due dates create the next visit before failure returns.
5. An owner wants "what is open?" without hunting chats.


MaintainX packages that loop well. Taskade Genesis packages the same loop as Workspace DNA you control.


Daily need MaintainX default Taskade Genesis living board


Work orders Native WO module Project board + statuses


PM schedules Basic on free; stronger on paid Recurring tasks + automations


Parts / POs Premium tier Pair an inventory tool; the board is not a warehouse


Mobile completion Excellent CMMS mobile Responsive app UI; not a rugged CMMS clone


Requesters Free requester accounts Intake forms / portal patterns


GPS Not a free add-on in either tool No fleet tracking here; keep telematics elsewhere

## 2026 MaintainX pricing reality


MaintainX is unusually transparent for CMMS.


Plan Price (typical public) What small shops notice


Basic Free Unlimited WOs for light teams; tight PM / analytics limits

Premium $65/user/mo annual ($75 monthly) Inventory, POs, API, meter-based PM depth

Requester accounts are free across plans. Paid users are people with unique logins who *use* the app to execute work.

## Migration playbook (MaintainX → Taskade Genesis)


Do not delete MaintainX on Friday before a holiday weekend.


1. **Export open WOs and asset list** (CSV is fine).
2. **Generate PM + WO boards** from the links above.
3. **Map statuses** 1:1 so techs do not learn a new language.
4. **Dual-run one site or one asset class** for two weeks.
5. **Move new requests** to the Taskade Genesis boards first; keep MaintainX for history.
6. **Add an agent digest** only after completion quality is trusted.
7. **Sunset** when open WO count in MaintainX hits zero for the pilot scope.


Week MaintainX Taskade Genesis Gate


0 Canonical Generate + import Field mapping signed off


1-2 Canonical Mirror + practice Techs complete 10 jobs in the new boards


3 Read-only pilot Canonical pilot No shadow clipboard


4+ Archive pilot assets Expand Keep CSV backup

## Cost and decision narrative


A shop on MaintainX Essential with five paid users spends about $100/month. That can be cheap insurance if the mobile CMMS habit is real. The pain starts when:


- You need Premium features for a minority of workflows.
- You are paying for users who only update status twice a week.
- You want an agent to draft weekly maintenance summaries inside the same system as customer context.
- You already run dispatch or customer portals elsewhere and hate the split brain.


Trigger Action


Free Basic limits block repeating PM Try Essential *or* the Taskade Genesis PM board


Premium quote for parts only Keep MaintainX Essential + separate inventory


Seat count > value of CMMS depth Pilot the Taskade Genesis boards


Need GPS Buy telematics; switching CMMS will not get you maps

## Free Basic: gift and trap


MaintainX Basic is a genuine gift. Unlimited work orders on a free plan beats vaporware freemium. The trap is subtle:


1. Teams build habits on Basic.
2. Repeating PM and analytics limits appear.
3. Essential feels mandatory.
4. A year later, inventory pressure pushes Premium quotes.
5. Nobody revisits whether a board would have been enough.


Treat Basic as a classroom, not a forever home, unless your volume truly stays light. Schedule a 90-day review with one question: "Are we buying CMMS depth, or are we renting a status board?"


Basic symptom Meaning Next step


Hitting repeating PM caps You outgrew free PM Essential or the Taskade Genesis PM board


Techs love the mobile app Switching cost is real Dual-run before any cut


Only leads update statuses Seat model may be wrong Owned board + fewer logins


Parts chaos weekly You may need Premium *or* inventory software Do not buy Premium for vibes


### Shop personas


**Clipboard Carl:** three techs, paper WO pads, no inventory system. Taskade Genesis WO + PM boards are often enough.


**Mobile Maya:** already lives in MaintainX Basic, loves photo closeout. Stay until a hard limit hurts, then dual-run.


**Premium Pat:** quoting Premium for parts and API. Separate the inventory buy from the board buy. Many shops only needed the board.


**Multi-site Morgan:** several buildings, shared parts, SSO later. Packaged CMMS (MaintainX Enterprise class or peers) usually wins. Taskade Genesis can still host a pilot board for one site.


### Implementation checklist (print this)


1. Name the system of record for open WOs during pilot.
2. Agree photo/notes standards so history stays useful.
3. Pick one asset class (for example HVAC only) for week one.
4. Ban a parallel spreadsheet for that class.
5. Review seat invoice vs board trust on day 14.

## FAQ


Is Taskade Genesis a MaintainX alternative?


For work orders and PM boards you own, yes as a category alternative. For a packaged mobile CMMS with inventory and meter APIs, no. Start at[/generate/dispatch/maintainx-pm-board](https://www.taskade.com/generate/dispatch/maintainx-pm-board) .


Should we leave MaintainX free Basic?


If Basic still matches your week, stay. Alternatives are for pain, not fashion.


How does this relate to UpKeep?


Same living-board story. See[UpKeep alternative](https://www.taskade.com/blog/upkeep-alternative-maintenance-teams) and the[UpKeep work order board](https://www.taskade.com/generate/dispatch/upkeep-work-orders) .


Can agents create PM work orders?


They can draft and remind. Keep humans approving anything that spends contractor money or shuts down a line.


Where do we start?


[/create](https://www.taskade.com/create) , generate the PM board, generate the WO board, dual-run one asset class.

A note on AI inside CMMS vs agents on your board


MaintainX markets AI assistants on higher tiers in some packages. That can be valuable inside a CMMS. It is a different bet from a workspace agent that can see customer context, dispatch notes, and PM due dates in the same Taskade workspace as your other ops apps. If your AI need is "summarize overdue WOs and draft a vendor email," Taskade Genesis agents are a direct fit. If your AI need is deeply tied to meter readings and parts forecasting inside MaintainX Premium/Enterprise, stay in the CMMS.


AI job Better home


Overdue WO digest Taskade Genesis agent on the WO board


Draft customer update Taskade Genesis agent with portal context


Parts reorder suggestion from bin levels CMMS / inventory tool


Meter threshold anomalies CMMS with meter integrations
